tara: Hey — day 2 onboarding question. I can ssh to bastion but I can't pull from internal docker registry (registry.redwood.internal). Browser resolves but `docker pull` times out. macOS 13.6 (M2).
marco: Did you use the onboarding WireGuard profile (onboarding-wg) or the full corporate VPN?
tara: onboarding-wg. I see the registry DNS -> 10.100.12.34 but ping fails.
it-ops: Can you paste `netstat -rn` and `scutil --dns` output? Also confirm you can SSH to bastion via its public gateway.
tara: Yep ssh to bastion works. netstat snippet:```
Destination        Gateway            Flags        Refs      Use   Netif Expire
default            192.168.1.1        UGSc           62        0     en0
10.100.0.0/16      192.168.50.2       UGSc            0        0     wg0
10.100.12.34       10.100.50.1        UHS             0        0     lo0
```
marco: Hmm that lo0 route for 10.100.12.34 looks suspect — local lookup maybe from a stale /etc/hosts entry or a leftover port-forward. Do `grep 10.100.12.34 /etc/hosts` and `lsof -i :5000` (or the registry port)
tara: grep returns nothing. lsof shows nothing on 5000.
sam: Are you doing docker over the system docker (Docker Desktop) or via podman in WSL? For Mac it's Docker Desktop. Docker sometimes uses its own networking; it won't route via wg0 by default.
tara: Docker Desktop. So how do I force Docker to use the host route?
alex: Two options: 1) Add a host route on the mac so traffic to 10.100.0.0/16 goes via the WireGuard gateway (172.31.0.1 in our profiles). Example:```sudo route -n add -net 10.100.0.0/16 172.31.0.1``` 2) Use Docker's daemon.json to add an extraHosts entry for registry.redwood.internal mapping to 10.100.12.34 (quick workaround).
marco: For onboarding we prefer a route because other tools need the network too. On mac the command above should persist if you wrap it in a small launchd job, but for troubleshooting run it manually first.
tara: Ran the route add and `docker pull` now works. Thanks!
it-ops: Great — two follow-ups: 1) Please open a ticket in #help with your machine serial so we can add the persistent route deployment to onboarding scripts. 2) We'll check why onboarding-wg profile gave a /16 route but Docker Desktop bypassed it; may be a Docker bug/version interaction.
tara: Filed ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-342 (link pasted). Tagging eng-infra per suggestion.
sam: One tip for others: if you see DNS resolve to a private IP but connections fail, check whether the app/container uses its own network namespace. Quick fix is host-level route or add the host mapping in Docker Desktop settings.
marco: Also: if you ever need to jump through bastion for registry (port-forward), these commands help:```ssh -J me@bastion.redwood.com registry-proxy -L 5000:10.100.12.34:5000``` but prefer fixing split-tunnel routing.
tara: Awesome — appreciate the quick help and explanations :clap:
alex: Welcome aboard! If anything else pops up ping eng-infra or new-hires.
